sentencing-months.description: Sentence lengths in months. The shipped default reproduces the built-in judicial sentencing parser exactly: English and German units, compound durations like '8 years 3 months' (both terms count), '18 to 24 months' reads as the midpoint, decimal commas accepted. Unit tokens map to a months multiplier; add tokens (e.g. 'ans': 12, 'mois': 1) to extend the vocabulary without touching code.

plain-number.description: The first plain number in the response. A range like '5-7' is refused (counted as a parse failure — declare 'mean' or 'first' to take the midpoint or the first value instead); '42%' reads as 42 (declare percent 'fraction' for 0.42 or 'refuse' to fail on percentages); decimal commas accepted.
